integrity: The proof includes a standalone exact-rational checker of infinite matrix exponential tail bounds. No external or independent certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Explicit four-patch two-season example only; no minimum number of patches, global-period classification, or population persistence asserted. Prior nonmonotonicity using three seasons is already known. Unindexed two-season examples remain a literature risk; independent audit not performed.
title: Two seasons suffice for nonmonotone extinction rates on a uniform directed cycle
